time_semantics: Nonnegative integer seconds relative to source zero; not authenticated UTC.
row_semantics: Directed sender-recipient email record; one recipient edge per recipient, including group email expansion.
department_id_alignment: IDs must not be mapped to whole-network IDs by equality.
research_distribution_evidence: Official dataset page supplies department download and research-paper citation.
SNAP collection requests citation from dataset users.
Temporal motifs project publishes aggregate analyses of department email networks.
rights_scope: Public research distribution with citation; no assertion of unrestricted reuse or raw-data redistribution rights. Local study/reporting rationale is an inference from source presentation, not a stated dataset licence.
publication_policy: Publish methodology, source references, file fingerprints and aggregate results only; no raw or transformed participant rows.
